title: Copper Chests
description: Gives normal Chests the appearance of Copper Chests introduced in Minecraft 1.21.9.
body:
**🪙 Copper Chests — Resourcepack 🪙**

Miss the Copper Chests from 1.21.9? Now you can have them in older versions!
This pack retextures normal and trapped chests to match the new copper variants from Minecraft 1.21.9.

Normal chests shine with the look of fresh copper, while trapped chests appear aged and oxidized.
It’s a simple, purely visual change that brings a modern touch to older worlds — perfect for builders who love consistency and detail.
